sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 29 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：QQQ、SPY、MSFT、AAPL、KOSPI。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • The KOSPI triggered circuit breakers for two consecutive days for the first time in history. SK Hynix delivered the most profitable quarter in company history, yet still fell short of market expectations. The index has erased more than 18% over two days, and July is on track to become the worst month on record for the KOSPI. The fallout spread to U.S. stocks: MU 789.61 (-3.77%, intraday low 784.73, briefly surged to 841 at the open), SNDK 1019.32 (-6.98%, intraday low 1004.78), DRAM 46.30 (-3.05%), and SKHY 129.87 (-0.23%, briefly spiked to 136 after the open before reversing).
  • Semiconductors fell for a fourth consecutive trading day, while the Nasdaq approached correction territory. Beyond Korea, catalysts included China’s CXMT completing Asia’s largest IPO this year—with proceeds earmarked for DRAM capacity expansion—and reports of breakthroughs in domestically produced Chinese lithography equipment. At this point, QQQ 667.82 (-1.12%), SOXL 97.97 (-10.53%, back into double digits), AMD 433.06 (-4.73%), NVDA 191.69 (-2.72%), CRWV 63.74 (-5.28%), and NBIS 155.13 (-8.60%).
  • The FOMC decision is due today, with consensus expecting rates to remain unchanged at 3.50–3.75%, but disagreement is unusually wide. CME data cited by the community showed a 64.2% probability of no change and a 35.8% probability of a 25bp hike, while Polymarket placed the probability of no change at approximately 75%. Since taking office, Warsh has avoided telegraphing decisions in advance, and a September hike is widely viewed as the real uncertainty. SPY 735.26 (-0.75%), intraday low 734.34.
  • Trump responded to Iran’s surprise attack on a U.S. military base by saying the U.S. would “beat the hell out of them.” Renewed fighting in the Middle East pushed Brent up more than 4% at one point to around $88. Combined with an unexpected 7.167 million-barrel decline in EIA crude inventories versus an expected increase of 700,000 barrels, USO reached 129.55 (+7.55%), making it the strongest asset in the market.
  • Earnings reactions remained sharply disconnected from results: VRT 233.08 (-13.49%) continued to be hammered after missing revenue expectations; SOFI beat on three fronts but still traded at 15.10 (-9.69%); STX 764.94 (+2.33%) was the only green name in the semiconductor chain. MSFT (393.91, +0.12%) and META (589.90, -0.57%) report after the close tonight, followed later by AMZN 227.81 (-1.27%) and QCOM.
  • The selloff broadened unusually sharply: DIA 519.06 (-1.47%) fell more than QQQ, while IWM declined 1.20%. The community noted that this was not a simple technology-to-value rotation, but rather “no rotation, only cash.” The only stock supporting the index was AAPL 341.31 (+0.38%), which reached another intraday record high.

社区气氛：极度疲惫的恐慌，但尚未投降——饲料中充满了“天天都是红色的”、“我的身家被削减了一半”、“我好累”的呼喊，还有对韩国散户投资者的同情。与此同时，抄底买盘、V 型反转的呼声以及对 FOMC 后猛烈反弹的押注仍然普遍存在。整体基调是一种黑色幽默的狂欢，融合了崩溃感和拒绝投降的感觉。

恐惧/贪婪程度：个股已经进入恐慌区域（8/10）——SNDK 在五天内下跌了 35%，NBIS 在三天内从 230 跌至 155，SOXL 跌破 100。多个用户报告账户被削减一半（100 万美元→63 万美元，12 万美元→3 万美元）。然而，在指数层面，情绪仍然保持中性，带有谨慎的偏见：SPY 比 ATH 低约 3%，VIX 仅为 19。社区反复嘲笑这种脱节：“这么多人被炸毁了，SPY 只下跌了 2%。” SPY/QQQ 期权 IV 被描述为“像石油一样昂贵”，而 0DTE 期权在 FOMC 日内的溢价则将零售交易者赶出市场。这是恐慌集中于波动而非价格的典型案例。

WSB 情绪与实际价格走势：社区情绪远比指数低迷，这种背离本身就是一个重要信号——零售头寸高度集中在内存/人工智能基础设施/杠杆 ETF，而指数则受到 AAPL 和防御性股票的支撑。整个上午，多头都在呼吁“上午 10 点 V”，但此时尚未实现，QQQ 仍接近盘中低点。相反，在交易的第一个小时内做空 QQQ 的机械策略已经在社区内被公开概括为“免费资金”，这表明这种共识交易本身正在变得拥挤。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及看涨/看跌情绪核心观点总结
MU60+中立（分歧很大）800分已经成为意识形态的战场，声称“只是暂时低于800分”。看多者援引 1660 亿美元的年化收入、5 倍的远期市盈率以及万亿美元的市值论点，认为该股受到了不公平的惩罚。看空者援引一位分析师的说法，称“到八月底将达到 400 家”。尽管部分用户多次成功换入换出，但大量1000/1200呼叫已归零。核心情绪是“一家每天暴涨又暴跌的万亿美元公司应该退市”。
